title: Salmon-Stuffed Avocados with Fresh Herbs
description: Rich in marine omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (EPA and DHA) and plant monounsaturated oleic acid. This lipid pairing elevates HDL, lowers circulating triglycerides, and improves cell-membrane insulin sensitivity.
diabeticNotes: Rich in marine omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (EPA and DHA) and plant monounsaturated oleic acid. This lipid pairing elevates HDL, lowers circulating triglycerides, and improves cell-membrane insulin sensitivity.

ingredients.name: medium ripe Hass avocado, sliced lengthwise and pitted
canned drained wild pink salmon or poached salmon flakes

steps.title: Hollow Avocado Halves
steps.description: Halve and pit avocado. Scoop out a thin layer of flesh to enlarge cavity, dicing scooped flesh.

steps.title: Flake Salmon & Aromatics
steps.description: In a bowl, combine wild salmon, diced avocado flesh, finely minced red onion, dill, and drained capers.

steps.title: Bind with Yogurt & Oil
steps.description: Add Greek yogurt, extra virgin olive oil, and fresh lemon juice to the salmon mixture.

steps.title: Fold Gently
steps.description: Fold ingredients together gently with a fork, keeping salmon flakes tender and chunky.

steps.title: Mound into Shells
steps.description: Mound the savory salmon salad generously into the prepared avocado halves. Garnish with fresh dill.
